name: aws_marketplace-mcp
description: AWS Marketplace (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool

platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_access_key_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_access_key_.description: AWS access key id of the seller account's IAM principal with aws-marketplace:ListEntities, DescribeEntity and SearchAgreements (e.g. the AWSMarketplaceSellerProductsReadOnly policy plus agreement read access).

platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_secret_acce.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_secret_acce.description: The matching AWS secret access key; only used to derive the SigV4 signing key.

platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_session_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_SESSION_TOKEN
platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_session_tok.description: Session token when the keys are temporary STS credentials.

platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_entity_type.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_ENTITY_TYPE
platform_mcp_aws_marketplace_entity_type.description: Catalog entity type of your listings: SaaSProduct, AmiProduct, ContainerProduct, DataProduct (or Offer).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verifies the keys by listing one of the seller's own entities (the Catalog API has no identity call).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: ListEntities (Catalog AWSMarketplace, OwnershipType SELF) for the configured entity type; `status` is Visibility (Public, Limited, Restricted, Draft). The `status` input is not applied. Cursor-paginated (NextToken).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: DescribeEntity (GET /DescribeEntity?catalog=AWSMarketplace&entityId=…): the entity's DetailsDocument (Description, PromotionalResources, Dimensions, SupportInformation, Targeting…) in `raw`; `id` is EntityId@RevisionId. Prices live on Offer entities (describe an offer id for its terms).

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: Agreement Service SearchAgreements (PartyType Proposer, AgreementType PurchaseAgreement): the purchase agreements buyers accepted on your offers — agreementId, buyer account, offer, product, status (ACTIVE, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, RENEWED, REPLACED, TERMINATED), epoch-second times. Amounts are not part of agreements (see the seller reports / GetAgreementTerms); `product_id` and `since` inputs are not applied.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: Agreement Service ListBillingAdjustmentRequests: seller-initiated billing adjustments (refunds) with agreementId (the sale id from list_sales), original invoice, amount, currency, status and epoch-second createdAt; `since` filters createdAfter.
